outline: 課程涵蓋網路與通訊的基礎和最新發展。內容包括:行動通訊系統；網際網路協定；2G/3G/4G和無線數位電視；IEEE 802.11技術；隨意網路和感測網路;無線個人網路，體域網路和大都會網路，網路安全，物聯網，5G與後5G。
schedule:
● Mobile Communication Systems
● Network Protocols
● Existing Wireless Systems
● IEEE 802.11
● Ad hoc networks
● sensor networks
● WPAN WMAN WBAN WMN
● Security
● Satellite systems (optional)
● IoT
● 5G and beyond (new)
scorePolicy:
小考20%
大考 (2次) 45%
口頭報告(課本部分章節) 25%
課程參與(出席 提問等) 10%
materials:
教科書:
Course handouts

參考書:
1. 曾恕銘編譯 無線通訊系統概論:行動通訊與網路, 東華書局, 4/e
2. D. P. Agrawal and Q. Zeng, Introduction to Wireless and Mobile Systems, CENGAGE learning, 4/e
3. 最新行動通訊網路論文與雜誌文章 (IoT物聯網, 5G and beyond 5G與後5G)
remarks: If the distance class becomes necessary, all lectures, exam, oral reports will be held via Microsoft Teams. We will have roll calls and you may be required to turn on the camera and mic in the class.
